about: every North Carolina State Board contest whose round mark or p changed when its rounds were keyed by place as well as name (M2's check c19, PR #69; the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 11:44: 'a round is the same contest only in the same place'). A contest of the same name on another date is now a round of this one only where their counties overlap. 'R': the mark (election words) corrected, p unchanged; 'C': the mark corrected and p now computed (all p = 0, one name on the ballot for each seat, which the false first-round mark had held); 'N': p now computed, its class now has 100 or more like races in earlier years; 'P': p moved, its class's like races in earlier years changed (contests the false marks had kept out of the pool are in it). Not listed: 809 contests whose not-computed reason changes only in its count of like races. No p outside North Carolina moves; the State Board's calibration test keeps its verdicts (data/local/backtest-ncsbe.json). data/local/REPORT.md section 9.
